assistant|bandung_shopping_option: Bandung factory outlets sell local and international brands at discounted prices
Pasar Baru is Bandung's oldest and largest traditional market
Braga Street has colonial buildings turned into cafes, restaurants, and boutique shops
Cihampelas Walk (Ciwalk) is famous for its denim street with jeans and jackets
Dago Street is home to boutiques, art galleries, and cafes popular with young shoppers
Rumah Mode is a popular factory outlet with Balinese-inspired architecture
Kartika Sari bakery is famous for chocolate brownies and Indonesian snacks
assistant|ciwalk_restaurant_option: Miss Bee Providore serves western and Indonesian cuisine with a cozy interior
Bakery & Co is a place for coffee and pastries
Raa Cha Suki & BBQ is a Thai restaurant with spicy dishes
Sumoboo is a Japanese shaved ice dessert place with many flavors and toppings
Holycow! Steakhouse by Chef Afit serves high-quality steaks at reasonable prices
assistant|miss_bee_signature_dish: Miss Bee's Nasi Goreng: fried rice with prawn crackers and fried egg
Yoghurt Granola Bowl: homemade granola, fresh fruit, and yogurt
Fried Chicken Burger: chicken patty with bacon, lettuce, tomato, aioli, and fries
Beef Rendang: slow-cooked beef in spicy coconut milk sauce
Chocolate Brownie: served warm with vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce
assistant|bandung_activity: Day trip to volcanoes Tangkuban Perahu and Kawah Putih near Bandung
Tour tea plantations such as Malabar Tea Plantation and Puncak Tea Garden
Visit Trans Studio Bandung, one of Indonesia's largest indoor theme parks
Shop at Paris Van Java mall with luxurious boutiques and modern architecture
Take a cooking class to learn traditional Indonesian dishes like nasi goreng, sate, rendang
Visit Saung Angklung Udjo cultural center for traditional music and dance performances
assistant|bandung_tea_house: Kampung Daun: tea house with traditional Sundanese architecture and gardens
Lawangwangi Creative Space: hilltop tea house with views of Bandung city
Calista Tea House: elegant tea house serving teas plus Indonesian and Western dishes
Original Dutch Tea House: colonial-style tea house with Dutch tea blends
